print.all: Take recycling & compost (Mon 7pm) and garbage (Thu 7pm) bins to the curb, bring them back the next day at 7pm. Keep the garbage area clean.

long.all: Take bins out at 7pm the evening before pickup, bring them back at 7pm on pickup day. Keep the garbage area clean: no bags on the ground, lids closed, never leave bags beside a full bin.

print.fall: Rake the leaves in front. If it snows: shovel and salt the entrance and stairs.
print.winter: After every snowfall: shovel the entrance and stairs, then salt.
print.spring_summer: Front garden maintenance: weeding, tidying, watering.

long.fall: Rake front leaves (paper bags, out with compost). Shovel and salt if it snows.
long.winter: After every snowfall: shovel the entrance and stairs, then salt. Keep bins reachable on pickup days.
long.spring_summer: Front garden maintenance: weeding, tidying, watering. Shovel and salt if a late snow falls.

print.fall: Rake the leaves in the back yard.
print.winter: Keep the back yard tidy (no regular task in winter).
print.spring_summer: Back garden maintenance: weeding, tidying, watering.

long.fall: Rake back-yard leaves (paper bags, out with compost).
long.winter: No regular task in winter. Keep the back yard tidy.
long.spring_summer: Back garden maintenance: weeding, tidying, watering.

print.all: Main door lock, light bulbs (entrance, hallways), stairs, other small fixes.

long.all: Main door lock and handle, light bulbs (entrance, hallways), stairs, other small fixes. Post what you fixed (and any receipt) in the WhatsApp group.
